alana.cho: quick FYI — Vendor contract VND-331 has an invoicing issue. Vendor credit for onboarding credit was applied against prepaid commitment and caused $33,600 of revenue to be recognized this month that should've stayed deferred. Invoices: VNDINV-331-04 & VNDINV-331-05. Need JE and note in month close.

rajiv.patel: can you confirm the amount and how it hit GL?

matt.blake: also want the billing run id and whether this affects any other vendor contracts.

billing-bot: billing-bot: AUTO-APPLY job 1877999000 applied credit VND-ONB-100 to invoices VNDINV-331-04/05. Log: /var/log/billing/autoapply/1877999000.log

alana.cho: calc pasted: total prepaid 96,000; applied credits this period 62,400; recognized in ledger 95, +? wait typo, recognized 96,000; expected recognized 62,400; over-recognized = 33,600. Worksheet link: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/VND-331-vendor-credit-worksheet.csv

rajiv.patel: propose JE: debit Sales Rev (GL 4000) 33,600; credit Deferred Rev (GL 2005) 33,600. Memo: "Reversal of vendor onboarding credit misapplied to prepaid commit (VND-331)." @elaine.ops please create JE and post before close.

elaine.ops: creating JE now, JE# 2029-APR-VND331-002 (pending). Will include links to invoice ids and billing log.

matt.blake: i'll open BE ticket to exclude vendor onboarding credits from commit proration. Ticket BE-4170.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-4170 - Exclude vendor onboarding credits from commit proration. Assigned matt.blake.

alana.cho: thanks. adding line to close pack and flagging potential follow-up sweep for other vendor contracts tomorrow.

rajiv.patel: noted. i'll run a quick query to find vendor credits applied to commit in last 6 months and share numbers.

elaine.ops: once JE posts, finance will update deferred revenue schedule and attach to month-end pack.

alana.cho: done, thanks team :thumbsup:
